traffic_forecast_summary: Based on Hosted API trial telemetry and roadmap. Trial: ~12k requests over 14 days (~858/day). Observed average QPS during trial: 0.6 QPS sustained, peak 6 QPS during batch windows. Token mix trial: 68% short (~120 tokens), 25% medium (~450 tokens), 7% long (~1800 tokens). Production 12-month forecast: baseline 8 QPS average (~690k requests/month), peak day projection 95 QPS (marketing/release), concurrency planning target 60 concurrent streams to meet p99 <250ms SLO. Prod token mix estimate: 60% short (avg 120 tokens), 30% medium (avg 600), 10% long (avg 1800). Estimated tokens/day ~26M, tokens/month ~780M. Primary cost drivers: long summaries and nightly embedding reindex jobs (embedding throughput ~8k vectors/min during batch windows).
dedicated_sizing_notes: SE recommended baseline Dedicated pool: 4 x A100-equivalent workers for steady 8 QPS with autoscale to 12 workers for peaks (95 QPS) and headroom for bursty reranking. Rationale: continuous batching and KV cache reduce per-token GPU time for short requests by ~30%. Suggested config: 2GB KV cache per worker, batching window 20ms for chat, longer batching for reranker. Customer variables to confirm: preferred p99 latency <250ms, monthly budget cap, preferred regions (us-east, eu-west). Customer receptive to monthly reserved capacity with 3:1 burst policy. Next action: deliver price model for 4/8/12 worker tiers and per-token estimates after Optimize recommendations.
